name: Brittany DiSalvo
bio: Clinical Associate Professor of Occupational Therapy at Clarkson, promoted in 2024 after teaching there since 2017. Her clinical background is primarily with older adults — skilled nursing facilities, travel therapy in Texas and New York's Southern Tier, and per-diem work with St. Lawrence Health in Potsdam. She holds a Vestibular Rehabilitation & Concussion Certification and leads community programming including CarFit older-driver events and a United Helpers fall-prevention program in Canton.
